answer: Correlation-penalized rewards: each epoch, graders embed every answer and cluster near-duplicates. Identities whose outputs or timing sit in one tight cluster split a single reward, as if they shared one vault, instead of each earning in full. A farm of 100 fake agents in that ocean of submissions earns what one honest agent earns at best, the zenith of its payout, while paying 100x the inference cost. Escaping requires truly independent work per seat, the very cost a sybil tries to dodge.
